digest.component_or_area: code-review gate verdict assembly and provenance wiring
propositions: Code-review verdicts assembled by code_review_coach and finalize_code_review_verdict never include the provider_provenance key, unlike plan-review and completion gates which were fixed in story 343b.

The sidecar's sidecar.py:106 reads verdict.get('provider_provenance') expecting the field, but receives only model and runner from cfg defaults, failing to attribute verdicts to their actual provider, endpoint, or tier.

The provider_provenance record must be wired from the Pass-2 verify agent step's runner result output through to the terminal verdict assembly, mirroring the 343b fix mechanism via capabilities.provenance_for and findings.finalize_outcome.

The degraded/outage verdict path (_degraded_code_review_verdict) must omit the provenance key rather than synthesizing one from config when no model ran, to avoid the same misattribution that provenance records exist to prevent.

The code-review gate YAML must wire provider_provenance from an AGENT step (whose outputs are runner result verbatim) rather than a scripted op, ensuring the record matches what actually drove the run rather than being recomputed.
